title: Mapping squares over an inert operadic projection
statement:
Use the quasicategories, coherent functors, mapping spaces, and homotopy fibres of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the category $L=N(\mathsf{LM}^{\otimes})$, its colour projections and operadic fibrations of [def-coef-left-module-operadic-encoding], and coherent composition of [lem-coef-infinity-mapping-composition]. Let $r:\mathcal E\to L$ be an operadic fibration; cocartesian lifts of non-inert arrows are not required. Let $w,z,\bar z$ be objects of $L$, let $f:w\to z$ be any arrow, and let $\theta:z\to\bar z$ be inert. Write $z=(\langle k\rangle,S)$ and $J=\{j\in\{1,\ldots,k\}:\theta(j)=*\}$. Let $X\in\mathcal E_w$, and let $v:Y\to Z$ be an $r$-cocartesian lift of $\theta$, with $Y\in\mathcal E_z$ and $Z\in\mathcal E_{\bar z}$. Choose inert colour projections $Y\to Y_j$ over $\rho_j:z\to c_j$. For a base arrow $b$, write $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal E}^{b}(T,T')$ for the homotopy fibre over $b$ of the map on mapping spaces induced by $r$. For every $h\in\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal E}^{\theta f}(X,Z)$, the maps obtained by projecting to the outputs discarded by $\theta$ induce a natural equivalence
$$\operatorname{hofib}_{h}\bigl(v_*:\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal E}^{f}(X,Y)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal E}^{\theta f}(X,Z)\bigr)\simeq\prod_{j\in J}\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal E}^{\rho_j f}(X,Y_j).$$
The equivalence retains the compatibility path $v b\simeq h$ and all its higher simplices, and is natural in the full coherent parameter diagrams of these data, for choices of colour projections and their cocartesian comparisons. The empty product is a point. In particular, if $u:X\to Z_0$ is over $\eta:w\to\bar w$ and $a:Z_0\to Z$ is over $g:\bar w\to\bar z$ with $g\eta=\theta f$, taking $h=a u$ identifies the left side with the space of coherent squares whose vertical edges are $u,v$, whose top edge is $a$, and whose bottom edge lies over $f$, relative to that specified base square. No algebra object, simplex-category diagram, or module-section equivalence is part of this assertion.

source.place: Higher Algebra (2017), Definition 2.1.1.10(2), Remark 2.1.1.14, and the operadic mapping-square calculation underlying Remarks 4.2.2.18 and 4.2.2.21 (printed pp. 174-175, 518-519). General relative inert-projection formulation expanded by the agent; the coherent-square interpretation uses the arrow mapping-space pullback formula. Online source read; WANTED: archived Higher Algebra in literature/. No Stacks tag states this infinity-operadic assertion.

Supporting foundation: Free coherent monad modules and their augmented free resolution. Supporting lemma: Underlying equivalences and operadic colimits of coherent modules.
